rfaq1.question: Nishyura nte ubukode bw'ukwezi?
rfaq1.answer: Fungura Ubwishyu maze uhitemo Ishyura ubukode ubu. Hitamo MTN Mobile Money, Airtel Money, cyangwa Kohereza kuri banki, andika nimero y'igikorwa cyangwa wohereze ifoto y'inyemezabwishyu, hanyuma wohereze.

rfaq2.question: Ni hehe nakura inyemezabwishyu z'ubukode bwanjye?
rfaq2.answer: Inyemezabwishyu zose zemejwe zigaragara ako kanya ku ipaji y'Ubwishyu (Reba inyemezabwishyu) no ku ipaji y'Inyandiko.

rfaq3.question: Nasuzuma cyangwa ngashyira umukono ku masezerano y'ubukode nte?
rfaq3.answer: Jya ku Masezerano urebe amabwiriza y'ubukode, itariki yo kwishyura, ingwate, kandi ufungure inyandiko yose y'amasezerano. Ushobora kureba mbere, gukuramo, cyangwa gushyira umukono ku masezerano ategereje.

rfaq4.question: Namenyesha nte ikibazo cyo gusana mu nzu ntuyemo?
rfaq4.answer: Jya kuri Gusana maze ukande Menyesha ikibazo gishya. Tanga umutwe usobanutse, icyiciro, uburemere, n'ibisobanuro kugira ngo nyir'inzu ategure gusana.

rfaq5.question: Bigenda bite iyo nyir'inzu yanditse imenyesha ry'umwenda w'ubukode?
rfaq5.answer: Uhambwa igihe cy'iminsi 3 cy'integuza mbere y'uko umwenda wemezwa. Mu Mateka y'ubukode, ushobora kwishyura umwenda cyangwa gutanga impaka hamwe n'inyemezabwishyu kugira ngo bisuzumwe.

rfaq6.question: Ese nk'umupangayi nshobora gushakisha inzu nshya no gusaba kuzisura?
rfaq6.answer: Yego. Koresha Shakisha inzu kugira ngo ushakishe inzu ziboneka ukurikije akarere, ingengo y'imari, n'ibyumba, wandikire ba nyir'inzu ibibazo, kandi usabe amasura.
